Include exactly 13 numbers in the response. In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with each passing day, she realizes that she's running out of time - literally. The Timekeeper is always one step ahead, and Rachel's only hope is to use her wits and her knowledge of the future to outsmart him.

With the help of a local detective, Jack, Rachel must unravel the mystery of The Timekeeper's true identity and motivations. But as they dig deeper, they uncover a web of deceit and corruption that goes all the way to the top.

As the body count rises, Rachel must use her skills to leave a trail of breadcrumbs for her colleagues back in the present. But with each passing hour, she's one step closer to being trapped in the past forever. Can she solve the mystery of The Timekeeper before it's too late, or will she become his next victim?

The clock is ticking, and the stakes are higher than ever. Rachel must use all her knowledge of forensics, psychology, and time travel to catch The Timekeeper before he strikes again. But as the deadline approaches, she realizes that she's not the only one who knows the truth - and that The Timekeeper has a few tricks up his sleeve.

Will Rachel be able to solve the mystery and catch The Timekeeper, or will she become the latest victim of his time-hopping reign of terror? The fate of the world hangs in the balance, and the clock is ticking down to 13:47 PM on March 13th, 1963. The Timekeeper's next move is just hours away, and Rachel must be ready."
